ALGORITHM.description: Key algorithm. Applicable values: ES256, ES384, ES512

PUBLIC_KEY_0.description: Use the path to the ECDSA public key or a hex string

PUBLIC_KEY_1.description: Use the path to the ECDSA public key or a hex string

TYPE.description: Certificate type. Applicable values: DEVELOPMENT, PRODUCTION

DATE.description: The date of creation of the certificate in the format: YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss. If not provided, the system time will be used
